About.name: Danijel Maksić
About.p1: I'm a self-taught Front-End web developer, focused on building interactive and responsive web applications, with a strong emphasis on user experience.
About.p2: My journey with programming actually started as a teenager, when I tried learning Java on my own. However, because of my poor knowledge of English at the time, it didn't go well. Years later, I came across Front-End web development, which combined my interests in IT and visual design.
About.p3: During the last three years I studied web development on my own, using every resource on the web I could find: documentation, forums, blogs, coding challenges, YouTube, courses and recently LLMs. Now I'm looking for opportunities to put it all into practice professionally.
